jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(7)(K) inventory: Sharon School District, a town school district in the White River Valley Supervisory Union (member town: Sharon). Operates PK-6; tuitions grades 7-12.
White River Valley Supervisory Union (official site).

board.post_note: Sharon SD: three directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a) (a warned expansion to five under section 423(b) failed in 2024), one 3-year seat elected each year at the floor annual meeting. No term ends are published.

sources.note: Sharon SD Annual Meeting Warning, March 3, 2025 (official warning text, district legal notice): Article 6, "To elect One School Director, for the term of three (3) years" -- one 3-year seat per year at the floor annual meeting. The board is three directors: the district's March 4, 2024 warning carried a petitioned Article 11 to increase the board from three to five under section 423(b), which FAILED 77-13 (meeting report). The same three directors sign the Jan. 2024 and Jan. 2025 warnings; the SU's published plan lists Davis, Moore and Livingston as Sharon's SU-board delegation, and Livingston's Feb. 25, 2026 legislative testimony is headed "Vice-Chair, Sharon School District Board." No official source publishes individual term ends (Davis's 2027 rests on a news report of the March 4, 2024 result and is NOT minted). Resolving documents: the 2025/2026 annual meeting minutes and the district's FY27 Annual Report.
